thread:
noah: Hi all, quick onboarding snag — I found the 'Service runbook' in Company Home but Duplicate is disabled. I need a copy in our team vault. Anyone know the exact flow?

devex-bot: Quick checks: are you in the Redwood workspace, and is the page a DB template or a locked master? If it's DB-managed you should create a new entry from the DB template, not duplicate the master. If it's locked/view-only you'll need edit perms.

noah: I'm in the workspace. The page shows a small database icon next to the title — so that sounds like the DB case. How do I create a new entry from the DB template?

people-ops: Correct — that icon means it's part of a database. Open the Runbooks DB -> New -> choose the template called "Service runbook (template)". That creates a fresh doc already wired with metadata. After creating, move it into your team's vault (Team Home > vault-name).

sumi: If you really need a literal duplicate of the master page (we discourage this), ask the page owner to unlock it briefly or give explicit "Can edit" rights, then use  -> Duplicate. But prefer the DB -> New flow so the Owner and properties are set.

noah: Good call, thanks. Another related thing: I couldn't find the Owner field on the new page. Where is that shown?

eng: DB-managed pages expose properties near the title bar. Hover the title and look for "Owner" or open the page properties panel (top-right). If Owner is blank, add a tiny doc-header at the top of the page like:

Owner: @team-contact
Last updated: YYYY-MM-DD
How to duplicate: DB -> New -> select template

people-ops: Also note mobile hides some controls (the template dropdown and three-dots menu). Use desktop for property edits or for moving pages between spaces. If you want, paste the page link here and we'll confirm permissions and move it into the vault for you.

noah: Thanks — I used Runbooks -> New and created the doc. Moved it to Team Home > vault-name and added the doc-header. Sharing the link here so you can confirm: https://notion.fake/runbook/abc123

people-ops: Confirmed — perms look good and Owner set to @eng. All set! Pro tip: add a short "doc-maintainers" list in the header so oncall knows who to ping during drills.

noah: Awesome, much smoother now. Appreciate the assist :thumbsup:
